items.item_text: Associate degree in related area and/or equivalent experience / training
Experience working with accounting fundamentals and understanding of the relationship between income, expense and balances sheet accounts and ledger reconciliation.
Accounting experience in a higher education environment, preferably UC.
Experience preparing complex reconciliations involving large quantities of data.
Experience analyzing, defining and resolving complex accounting problems within an electronic environment.
Experience using Customer Relationship Management Systems.
High level of experience using electronic financial accounting systems and spreadsheet, work processing and electronic email and calendaring applications.
Experience with higher functionality of Excel spreadsheets including V-Lookups and pivot tables.

Working with the General Accounting Supervisor, perform monthly bank reconciliation functions, review departmental inquiries on a broad spectrum of ledger and policy issues, prepare inter-campus journals including orders, charges, and fund transfers, prepare recurring monthly journals, manage several General Accounting accounts, approve documents that route to General Accounting, handle all aspects of the agency account and other university related event account processes, monitor reports for compliance and advise departments on how to correct report errors.
Knowledge and skill to work in a customer services environment, including assisting clients by phone or in person.
Organizational skills to organize, plan, coordinate and set priorities effectively; multi-task and adapt to changing priorities on multiple projects.
